scope.default: Keep the native session utilities outlet available before the first turn; title, actions, tabs and single corner semantics are unchanged
scope.boundary: Only the official client renderer is patched. Registered utilities retain their own session, content and authorization conditions; blank rows right-align utilities next to the preserved native corner
limitations: All existing session utilities may render for a blank session; no provider or authorization is synthesized
A sessionless header remains governed by the official ConversationHeader owner boundary
